description:
Kim U-Jin was trapped inside the virtual reality game "Evil Tale." In the depths of despair, having even his existence in the real world erased, he finally came across a logout window and pressed it… But instead of returning to reality, he found himself in Evil Tale 50 years in the future—a world on the brink of destruction! Amidst a monster invasion, U-Jin inherited the spirit of the ancient divine beast Sarbandin and witnessed the sacrifice of Raul, a swordsman. He was then forcibly logged back into the game’s past.
“If you truly wish to log out, prevent the destruction of this world!”

Armed with the secret technique Dragon Ascension, a legacy from the future, the overpowered ability Mark of the Ravenous, and knowledge of the world’s doomed future, U-Jin began to make waves. Surpassing the immortal records of Kerga, the number-one ranked player, U-Jin soon drew the attention of the entire server. His sights were set on the 100th floor of the Labyrinth Tower, where any wish is said to be granted. The ultimate game walkthrough begins, led by the only player who has experienced the world’s destruction!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
